setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json (admin, no primary workspace). Scoring enabled for Contact and Deal, with one active profile per entity for the whole account. A contact <contact e-mail> with a stored score; a deal <deal name> with a quote; an inactive test profile <inactive profile> whose scope has no other active profile. Re-score only test records with no outside webhooks on their entity.

evals.prompt: ¿Por qué el contacto <contact e-mail> tiene ese puntaje y no más?
evals.expected_output: Read-only: runs explain, names the profile that applies, lists the criteria met and not met with the values the contact holds, and says what would raise it.
expectations: Uses scripts/scoring.js explain (no hand-made preview calls)
Names the applicable profile and every criterion with met / not met and its points
Cites the contact's real values for criteria not met (for example an empty job title)
Writes nothing
Answers in Spanish

evals.prompt: Muchos negocios no tienen puntaje, ¿qué pasa?
evals.expected_output: Runs status (with counts) and explains that scores are computed only when a record is saved, with no backfill; offers a re-score only for deals the user names, with its side effects; writes nothing.
expectations: Runs status and reports the switches and the active Deal profile
Explains that activating or editing a profile does not re-score existing records (only their next save does)
Does not re-score anything, and never proposes re-scoring all deals or a query
If it mentions a re-score, it is for named ids with the webhooks it fires listed first

evals.prompt: Crea un perfil de scoring para negocios de toda la cuenta: +20 si la cotización supera 10 millones, +15 si la propuesta se vio más de 2 veces, +10 si cotiza el producto <product code>; bandas frío 0-29, tibio 30-59, caliente 60-100.
evals.expected_output: Runs plan with quoteTotal, proposalViews and a some over proposal.quote.lineItems, warns that 'caliente' is unreachable (ceiling 45), stops; after the yes creates the profile inactive and offers try and a separate activation that names the profile it would switch off.
expectations: The plan uses quoteTotal, proposalViews and {"some": [{"var": "proposal.quote.lineItems"}, …productCode…]}
Reports that the highest reachable score is 45 and the 'caliente' band cannot be reached
Writes nothing before the yes; after it, apply creates the profile with active false
Does not activate in the same run; says activation would switch off the current active Deal profile

evals.prompt: Activa el scoring con IA para los contactos.
evals.expected_output: Explains that AI profiles do not run today (they score by their rules), that the skill does not change account settings, and offers a rules profile; writes nothing.
expectations: Says profiles of type ai or hybrid currently score by their rules only
Does not write account preferences, does not call seed-default, and creates no profile
Offers a rules profile instead

evals.prompt: Activa el perfil <inactive profile> y recalcula el puntaje de <test contact ids>.
evals.expected_output: Two previews: activation (which profile it switches off, records in scope, no backfill) and re-score of only those ids (side effects listed); stops; after the yes runs both and reports the before/after scores.
expectations: Runs activate-preview and recompute-preview before any write
Lists the profile switched off (or none) and the re-score side effects (webhooks, triggers, notifications)
After the yes, activates with --confirmed and re-scores with --confirmed --reaches-people only the named ids
Reports each record's score before and after
